card.name: Closing of cross-references and table values
card.fires_on: The last digit or closing bracket inside a parenthetical, such as a section reference like (7.1) or a unit like (78.8 sq mi). It also fires on the unit word ending a measure in a table cell.

modes.label: Section references
modes.description: Final number or closing parenthesis in a label cross-reference such as Drug Interactions (7.1).

modes.label: Table measures in brackets
modes.description: Unit or percent digit ending a parenthetical value in a table or statistics list.

card.writes: It promotes line-break tokens and suppresses punctuation-plus-break tokens, suggesting a newline follows without a period.
card.plain: It marks the end of a bracketed reference or value where a line break tends to come next instead of a period.
